posts.zh:
dsh-remote 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。远程工作区：SSH 密码或 key 连接远程主机，选取远程工作区目录，用 rw_pick_workspace / rw_list_dir / rw_read_file / rw_exec 工具在远程直接操作。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-b63e871a27d4efbe0ba8.html
posts.en:
dsh-remote is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Remote workspace: connect a host over SSH (password or key), pick a remote workspace directory and operate on it with rw_pick_workspace / rw_list_dir / rw_read_file / rw_exec tools.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-b63e871a27d4efbe0ba8.html
